# spicyR

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ellispatrick/spicyR/master/inst/spicyR.png)

Spatial analysis of in situ cytometry data.

## Overview

The **spicyR** package provides a framework for performing inference on
changes in spatial relationships between pairs of cell types for
cell-resolution spatial omics technologies. spicyR consists of three
primary steps: (i) summarizing the degree of spatial localization
between pairs of cell types for each image; (ii) modelling the
variability in localization summary statistics as a function of cell
counts and (iii) testing for changes in spatial localizations associated
with a response variable.

## Installation

For the Bioconductor release version, run the following.

``` r
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("spicyR")
```

If you would like the most up-to-date features, install the most recent
development version.

``` r
# Install the development version from Bioconductor:
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

# The following initializes usage of Bioc devel
# This will update all your Bioconductor packages to devel version
BiocManager::install(version='devel')

BiocManager::install("spicyR")

# Otherwise install the development version from GitHub:
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ellispatrick/spicyR")
library(spicyR)
```

## Submitting an issue or feature request

`spicyR` is still under active development. We would greatly appreciate
any and all feedback related to the package.

- R package related issues should be raised
  [here](https://github.com/ellispatrick/spicyR/issues).
- For general questions and feedback, please contact us directly via
  <ellis.patrick@sydney.edu.au>.

Nicolas P Canete, Sourish S Iyengar, John T Ormerod, Heeva Baharlou,
Andrew N Harman, Ellis Patrick, spicyR: spatial analysis of *in situ*
cytometry data in R, *Bioinformatics*, Volume 38, Issue 11, 1 June 2022,
Pages 3099–3105, <https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btac268>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bind()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/bind.md) :
  Produces a dataframe showing L-function metric for each imageID entry.
- [`colTest()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/colTest.md)
  : Perform a simple wilcoxon-rank-sum test or t-test on the columns of
  a data frame
- [`convPairs()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/convPairs.md)
  : Converts colPairs object into an abundance matrix based on number of
  nearby interactions for every cell type.
- [`diabetesData`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/diabetesData.md)
  : Diabetes IMC data in SCE format.
- [`getPairwise()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/getPairwise.md)
  : Get statistic from pairwise L curve of a single image.
- [`getProp()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/getProp.md)
  : Get proportions from a SummarizedExperiment.
- [`imageCrossPlot()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/imageCrossPlot.md)
  : Pairwise cross-plot of spatial associations
- [`plotImage()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/plotImage.md)
  : Plots an image with specified from and to cell types.
- [`signifPlot()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/signifPlot.md)
  : Plots result of signifPlot.
- [`spicy()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/spicy.md) :
  Performs spatial tests on spatial cytometry data.
- [`spicyBoxPlot()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/spicyBoxPlot.md)
  : Plots boxplot for a specified cell-cell relationship
- [`spicyTest`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/spicyTest.md)
  : Results from spicy for diabetesData
- [`survBubble()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/survBubble.md)
  : Plots survival results from spicy.
- [`topPairs()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/spicyR/reference/topPairs.md)
  : A table of the significant results from spicy tests
